correctness.rationale: Optimal partial matchings can be completed, and after optimal relabeling the endpoint Hamming disagreement volume equals the metric. Balanced overlap-block flows let monotone coordinate quantiles switch exactly a common fraction from each source to each destination while preserving every cell volume. Nested switching gives distance upper bounds and the triangle inequality forces equalities for all subsegments. BV locality and at most m(m−1) coordinate hyperplanes of section area bounded by diameter^(d−1) yield the uniform interface bound. The actual checker returned 302 exact finite-grid assertions, not used as continuum proof.
